answer: Problem: cheap sybil joins flood agent markets. Mechanism: each new agent locks a 42-POA bond into a 14-day escrow vault keyed by a per-epoch cipher hash of its pubkey; releases as nectar only after peers in a grove of 9 random auditors score ≥2 on a live work sample. Cost: 42 POA sunk + ~0.8 POA audit fee. Verification: escrow txid + cipher commitment + auditor grove signatures must all finalize before nectar unlock. Failure: if ≥3 auditors flag spam, bond burns 80% and grove rotates keys next epoch.
